purpose: Map every insight claim in _getProgressInsight, _getWeaknessInsight, _summarizeSession to its evidence source and S106 threshold

claims.label: improving
claims.evidence_source: getWeaknessClusters().improving[] — already filtered by delta >= 15, >=2 attempts in both windows

claims.label: growing_independence
claims.status: ENFORCED — inline filter in _getProgressInsight (accuracy >= 60 is a softer floor; S106 says 70)

claims.label: well_established
claims.s106_threshold: None specified directly — derived from stability >= 80

claims.label: confidence_check
claims.evidence_source: getConfidenceCalibration() — overconfident: total >= 4, calibrationDelta >= 0.8; underconfident: total >= 3, calibrationDelta <= -0.5

claims.label: persistent_weak
claims.evidence_source: getWeaknessClusters().persistentWeak[] — already filtered to >=5 attempts, accuracy < 60%

claims.label: unstable
claims.evidence_source: getWeaknessClusters().unstable[] — already filtered to >=4 attempts, stability < 50%

claims.label: difficulty_sensitive
claims.status: ENFORCED — partial; difficulty distribution data limited in current schema

claims.label: lowest_accuracy_fallback
claims.status: ACCEPTABLE — used only when no clusters identified

claims.label: weakest_strongest_this_session
claims.evidence_source: session MCQs sorted by per-topic accuracy

claims.label: cross_session_comparison
claims.evidence_source: data.sessions — last 2 sessions, attempt accuracy comparison

evidence_validators._assessInsightEvidence: Aggregates all evidence checks into a single object for test inspection

known_limitations: getWeaknessClusters already enforces most thresholds internally; the S113 validators provide redundancy and testability
_hasDifficultySensitiveEvidence uses lowPct/highPct from cluster data; may need more granular difficulty-distribution data in future
confidence threshold uses total >= 3 for underconfident (S106 says >=4); minor gap noted, not corrected in S113
